response: The Global Longitudinal Pathway has indeed had a positive influence on medical students' skills and attitudes toward culturally diverse populations. According to the findings, clear and distinct differences were found between the two studied groups, indicating that the increased confidence in working with diverse populations may have developed due to exposure to the Pathway program. This suggests that the curriculum has been effective in shaping medical students' skills and attitudes, ultimately preparing them to better serve and interact with culturally diverse patient populations.
